full_prompt_en: A square blue-hour architectural photograph shows an angular cluster of pale blue volumes standing on a narrow platform above still water. Near the center, a tall translucent glass section reveals a winding interior stair that curls from the lower floor toward an upper landing. Warm cream light glows through the glass, making the stair and structural edges readable against cool exterior walls. To its right, a broad vertical wall curves gently at the top like a partial cylinder, while lower rectangular volumes step outward toward the right edge. At the left, a smaller glass box projects over a short supporting volume, its interior also warmly lit. Another broad glazed room occupies the right ground floor; a tiny standing figure or upright object is visible near its far-right area, though detail is limited by distance. The building sits on a slim light-colored base that projects into a dark, glassy pool. In the lower half, reflections of the glowing windows and blue walls stretch downward in softened vertical bands. The background is a plain misty blue-gray evening sky with little visible landscape, allowing the complicated form to read as a silhouette of blocks, curves, and transparent voids. Diffuse twilight supplies cool even light, while the interior illumination makes localized warm rectangles and shadows inside. Smooth opaque surfaces contrast with reflective glass and water. The camera is level and frontal from across the pool, keeping the entire structure within the frame. The composition balances tall central rises against low side wings, with a dark reflective base doubling the luminous geometry.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形蓝色时刻建筑照片描绘一组棱角分明的浅蓝体块，立在静水上方的窄平台上。中央附近，一段高大的半透明玻璃部分透出弯曲室内楼梯，从下层盘向上方平台。暖奶油色灯光透过玻璃，使楼梯和结构边缘在冷色外墙前可读。其右侧，一面宽阔竖墙的顶部轻轻弯成部分圆柱形，更低的长方体向右边缘逐级伸出。左侧，一个较小玻璃盒从短支撑体上挑出，内部也有暖光。右侧底层还有一间宽阔玻璃房；远右区域可见一处极小站立人影或竖向物，但距离使细节有限。建筑位于伸入深色镜面水池的细浅色底座上。下半幅，发亮窗面和蓝色墙体的倒影向下拉成柔化竖带。背景是素净朦胧的蓝灰傍晚天空，几乎看不到风景，使复杂形体作为块、曲面和透明空处构成的剪影清楚可读。漫散暮光提供冷而均匀的照明，室内灯光则形成局部暖色矩形和内部阴影。平滑不透明表面与反光玻璃及水面形成对照。相机从池对面平齐正面拍摄，把整体结构收在画内。构图用高起中央平衡低矮两翼，深色反光基面将发亮几何加倍。
style_prompt_en: Blue-hour photography contrasts cool opaque planes with transparent warm-lit sections and a dark reflective base. Arrange tall and low geometric masses in an offset but balanced rhythm, using one curved edge to soften a mostly rectilinear silhouette. Let glass reveal internal depth and circulation, while matte outer surfaces remain calm and simple. Diffuse dusk light gives broad blue-gray modeling without sharp daytime shadows; local amber light creates legible inner layers and soft vertical reflections below. Keep the surrounding field nearly empty so the form and its mirrored echo dominate. Fine seams and faint material grain may remain visible, but color separation and light transmission carry the effect. The transferable visual language is serene, spatial, and quietly luminous, built from cool-warm contrast, translucent depth, and still reflection.
style_prompt_zh: 蓝色时刻摄影以冷色不透明平面对照透光暖亮区和深色反光基面。让高低几何体以错位却均衡的节奏排列，用一条曲边柔化主要由直角构成的剪影。玻璃显露内部纵深和通行关系，哑光外表则平静简洁。散射暮光提供宽泛蓝灰塑形，没有白天的锐利投影；局部琥珀光形成可读内部层次及下方柔软竖向倒影。周围色场几乎空白，让形体和镜像回声占主导。细接缝与浅材料颗粒可保留，但色彩分离与透光关系才是关键。可迁移的视觉语言宁静、有空间感且悄然发亮，根基是冷暖对照、半透明纵深和静止反射。
theme_en: Blue volumes and glowing glass rooms beside a reflecting pool at dusk
theme_zh: 暮色中蓝色体块与发光玻璃房间立于反光水池旁
name: Steven Holl
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
